## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| --- | --- |
| [DBL Array Constant](other_constants/double_precision.md) | Palette icon for a constant array of double-precision numbers. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [Integer Array Constant](other_constants/integer.md) | Palette icon for a constant array of signed 32-bit integers. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [Boolean Array Constant](other_constants/boolean.md) | Palette icon for a constant array of Booleans. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [String Array Constant](other_constants/string.md) | Palette icon for a constant array of strings. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [Waveform Array Constant](other_constants/waveform.md) | Palette icon for a constant array of waveforms. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [Timestamp Array Constant](other_constants/timestamp.md) | Array of Timestamp constants with time (milliseconds) and date on two lines. Click a cell to edit its date/time in UTC. Cancel and unchanged acceptance preserve the stored value. |

| [Cluster Array Constant](other_constants/cluster.md) | Palette icon for a constant array of clusters. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [Error Array Constant](other_constants/error.md) | Palette icon for a constant array of errors. Placement is not implemented yet. |
